title: Discussing the Order of Points on a Loop
full_prompt: Create a Manim visualization based on the `DiscussOrderOfPoints` scene from 3Blue1Brown's 'inscribed_rect' series. The scene should define a loop (using an SVG or custom VMobject) and track points moving along this loop. It should implement helper methods to create movable pairs or quads of dots (using `ValueTracker` and custom update functions), draw connecting lines, midpoints, polygons, and labels that dynamically track these moving dots. The main scene `DiscussOrderOfPoints` should demonstrate the ordering of points (e.g., A, B, C, D) along the loop, highlighting how their relative positions change or are maintained as they slide along the curve.

common_failure_modes.note: The code references an external SVG file. A fallback parametric loop or inline VMobject should be used if the SVG is missing.
Manim Community Edition does not support .f_always or .always syntax; standard updaters or .add_updater must be used instead.
These are custom 3b1b Mobjects. Standard Dot or custom Group of Dots with varying opacity/radius should be used as fallbacks.
